text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 216 vials of insulin detemir 100 units/mL 10 mL SDV (NDC 50090127600) at 10.9 vials per day, providing 19.8 days on hand. Corvale General holds 264 vials at 12.2 vials per day, providing 21.7 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include insulin detemir as of 2026-10-21. The product label names A-S Medication Solutions as labeler and a registered plant with FEI 1450743. FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended 2026-08-12 and was classified VAI, with the classification known on 2026-10-14. The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately three weeks of supply at both campuses. No national shortage is declared. The 2026 VAI classification and the 2017 Warning Letter do not currently indicate a supply disruption for this NDC.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard inventory monitoring and weekly days-on-hand reporting to the P&T Committee for awareness.
2. Maintain current allocation practices across both campuses; Pharmacy Director to approve any inter-campus transfers.
3. Request manufacturer confirmation of production schedule and release timelines for NDC 50090127600; Buyer to initiate and report findings to Pharmacy Director.
4. Evaluate alternative long-acting insulin formulary options for contingency planning; P&T Committee to review and approve therapeutic alternatives.

Not recommended: Initiating shortage mitigation protocols, rationing, or mandatory therapeutic substitutions at this time.
